name: stm32-f429zi-webreact
description: Frontend React para STM32F429ZI FreeRTOS + LwIP HTTP server

scripts.makefs: node -e "process.exit(process.platform==='win32'?0:1)" && npm run makefs:win || npm run makefs:unix
scripts.makefs:defl: node -e "process.exit(process.platform==='win32'?0:1)" && npm run makefs:win:defl || npm run makefs:unix:defl
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run makefs
scripts.build:compressed: npm run build:web && npm run makefs:defl
scripts.build:debug: npm run build:web:debug && npm run makefs
